from f086 import anti_shuffle

import pytest


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    ("s", "expected"),
    [
        ("cba", "abc"),
        ("hello", "ehllo"),
        ("Hi", "Hi"),
        ("zyx cba", "xyz abc"),
        ("dcba fedc", "abcd cdef"),
        ("Hello World!!!", "Hello !!!Wdlor"),
        ("321 654", "123 456"),
        ("cba!", "!abc"),
        ("ba  dc", "ab  cd"),
        ("", ""),
        ("a", "a"),
        ("b a", "b a"),
        ("cba! ", "!abc "),
    ],
)
def test_anti_shuffle_sorts_characters_within_each_word(s, expected):
    result = anti_shuffle(s)
    assert result == expected
    assert len(result) == len(s)
    assert sorted(result) == sorted(s)


def test_anti_shuffle_preserves_spaces_and_word_structure():
    s = "zyx  cba fed"
    result = anti_shuffle(s)

    assert result == "xyz  abc def"
    assert [i for i, ch in enumerate(result) if ch == " "] == [
        i for i, ch in enumerate(s) if ch == " "
    ]
    assert len(result.split(" ")) == len(s.split(" "))
    for original_word, result_word in zip(s.split(" "), result.split(" ")):
        assert sorted(result_word) == sorted(original_word)
        assert list(result_word) == sorted(original_word)


def test_anti_shuffle_words_are_sorted_and_idempotent():
    s = "python is fun"
    result = anti_shuffle(s)

    assert result == "hnopty is fnu"
    assert all(list(word) == sorted(word) for word in result.split(" "))
    assert anti_shuffle(result) == result


def test_anti_shuffle_empty_and_blank_strings():
    assert anti_shuffle("") == ""
    assert anti_shuffle(" ") == " "
    assert anti_shuffle("  ") == " "
    # "  ".split(" ") gives three empty words, joined by two spaces.
    assert anti_shuffle("  ") == "  "
    assert anti_shuffle("a  ") == "a  "
```
